facebook.caption:
This place fixes something you didn't know was broken.

Dinh Cậu sits at the edge of Phu Quoc's harbor. A small shrine to the sea goddess, a blue-and-white striped lighthouse, fishing boats drifting past at golden hour. No resort. No queue. Just wind and water.

4.5 stars from 3,828 people who clearly needed this too.

Go at sunset. Stay longer than you planned.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
